events.title: Samsung Galaxy S20 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S20 — 120 Hz displays and 5G across the line — COVID-era flagship launch.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained Android's volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. 120 hz displays and 5g across the line — covid-era flagship launch. Developers testing Android builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-Pixel reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S20 continued Samsung's annual Android flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of Android users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.

events.title: Solana mainnet beta launches
events.summary: Solana launched mainnet beta on March 16, 2020 — a high-throughput blockchain using proof-of-history alongside proof-of-stake.
events.about: Solana targeted sub-second finality and thousands of transactions per second for DeFi and NFT mints. Rust smart contracts and cheap fees attracted traders during the 2021 bull run — and later outages reminded developers that speed trades off against decentralization narratives.

narrative.whyChosen: Solana became the leading Ethereum-alternative L1 for high-frequency on-chain apps.
narrative.whyImportant: It pushed the industry to compare throughput, fees, and validator counts across chains.
narrative.problemSolved: Ethereum layer-1 congestion made low-fee trading and gaming impractical at peak demand.

events.title: WHO declares COVID-19 a global pandemic
events.summary: The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic on March 11, 2020 — triggering worldwide lockdowns and the largest sudden shift to remote work in history.
events.about: Offices emptied overnight; Zoom, Teams, and Slack usage exploded; e-commerce and cloud infrastructure strained under demand. Developers shipped contact-tracing apps, vaccine portals, and WFH tooling at breakneck speed — permanently normalizing distributed teams, async communication, and hybrid office policies across tech.

narrative.whyChosen: The pandemic declaration marks the day remote work became the default for millions of developers.
narrative.whyImportant: It accelerated cloud adoption, digital transformation, and async engineering culture by years.
narrative.problemSolved: This was a public-health crisis — tech's role was enabling continuity when in-person work stopped.
